_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 01: 2023-10-24 to 2023-12-30. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord told him to make a video asking what viewers are believing for in 2024 and to encourage them to believe for the impossible.
mentions.quote: I want you to make a video entitled what are you believing for in 2024
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an instruction to believe, with no observable outcome claimed.

mentions.claim_text: Personal examples of what to believe for, a bigger house and family needs, and a story about praying in October with a man asking for a spouse.
mentions.quote: we're believing for a bigger house for our family
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: personal testimony, no claim about the world.

mentions.claim_text: Write the vision down and make it plain, believe bigger than you are believing, and you will look back at the end of 2024 and see it.
mentions.quote: write the vision down and make it plain what are you believing for
mentions.condition_text: conditional on getting the love walk right and writing the vision down
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: personal answered-prayer outcomes are not externally observable.

mentions.claim_text: Advice to get a Bible translation you can actually read and to read it repeatedly, with the promise that your life will change.
mentions.quote: get a Bible that you can understand
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: devotional advice, no observable criterion.

mentions.claim_text: Closing prayer calling prodigals back to Jesus and calling in healings for people crippled or bound so long they have lost hope.
mentions.quote: the healing power of Jesus would flow through them in the name of Jesus
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion distinguishes answered from unanswered here.

mentions.claim_text: Praying with his wife, he is shown calendars and can see clearly into January, February and March, where the wicked are plotting things against the American people.
mentions.quote: I could see into January really clear I could see into February March
mentions.falsify_match: A plot against the American public exposed in the first quarter of 2024.
mentions.falsify_miss: Q1 2024 passes with no such exposure.

mentions.claim_text: He hears that great grace will be poured out over 2024 and sees a grace wave accelerating across January to May, with the spiritual atmosphere over finances changing and a supernatural outpouring of money.
mentions.quote: great Grace will be poured out over 2024 a great grace
mentions.falsify_match: A widely reported wave of unusual financial provision among churchgoers in early 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a great wave of money falling on the just and the unjust alike in 2024, and separately a defusing of another virus plot that deflates like a released balloon around April.
mentions.quote: I saw a defusing of another plot of a virus a defusing
mentions.falsify_match: A 2024 disease scare that is talked up and then fizzles without becoming a pandemic.
mentions.falsify_miss: Either no scare at all, or one that becomes a genuine pandemic.

mentions.claim_text: He calls for prayer for the protection of a presidential candidate, seen outdoors before a big crowd with mountains behind, then in 2025 a massive thick slate wall like the Hoover Dam.
mentions.quote: for protection for presidential candidate I saw it Out outdoors
mentions.condition_text: he asks the audience to intercede specifically for the candidate's protection
mentions.falsify_match: An attempt on a US presidential candidate at an outdoor event before a large crowd.
mentions.falsify_miss: No attempt on any candidate through 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He places the dam-wall vision by Ireland, then says he was pulled back out of 2025 into 2024 to intercede over the nearer season.
mentions.quote: by um Ireland that that up like that area is where this was at
mentions.falsify_match: A barrier, blockade or dam-like structure of note in the North Atlantic near Ireland in 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says 2024 will be a good year with a great grace over it, while allowing that bad things will happen too, and urges intercession over what he has been shown.
mentions.quote: 2024 is going to be a good year
mentions.falsify_match: 2024 is on balance a good year by his own framing.
mentions.falsify_miss: 2024 is dominated by disaster; note this sits against his own winter-2024 crash claim.

mentions.claim_text: The sins of major American cities will consume the people who stay, and he says there comes a time to leave and to flee for your life.
mentions.quote: these cities the sins of those cities are going to consume
mentions.falsify_match: Sustained net outflow from major US cities tied to disorder.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cities hold or grow their populations.

mentions.claim_text: Cities will become so lawless, with district attorneys refusing to prosecute felons, that robbery and murder are on every hand while residents stay on blindfolded.
mentions.quote: cities are going to become so Lawless
mentions.falsify_match: Violent crime rises sharply in cities with declination-policy prosecutors.
mentions.falsify_miss: Urban violent crime falls or holds steady.

mentions.claim_text: Because innocent blood has been shed in Israel, the retribution of God is coming and it will not be pretty, with events also expected in the nations around Israel and in Gaza.
mentions.quote: we're going to see the retribution of God and it's not going to be pretty
mentions.falsify_match: The war widens into the states bordering Israel.
mentions.falsify_miss: The conflict stays contained to Gaza.

mentions.claim_text: He frames his role as a meteorologist reporting a low pressure system out in the Pacific: things are coming that will not hit immediately but are working their way toward us.
mentions.quote: there's some things that's not going to happen right at the moment
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an explicit statement that timing is indeterminate.

mentions.claim_text: A Christmas sign-off saying 2024 will be an amazing year in which the body of Christ soars on eagles' wings, with big things coming.
mentions.quote: big big things are coming in 2024 for the body of Christ
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion for the body of Christ soaring.

mentions.claim_text: Testimony about warts covering his body being healed after nearly a year of anointing with oil, used to teach that your want-to must outweigh your circumstances.
mentions.quote: my want to being healed was great
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: past personal testimony, no forward claim.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching on standing against torment, with the image of an inflatable clown punching bag that keeps rising back up.
mentions.quote: greater is he that is in me than he that is in the world
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching, no claim.

mentions.claim_text: Opening: he introduces himself as a prophetic intercessor shown things that are coming and told how to pray, and says he will cover where 2024 is heading.
mentions.quote: the Lord will show me things that are coming
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing, no claim.

mentions.claim_text: Taken up in the spirit he is shown December and then January, where he sees Joe Biden alongside the image of a television with no signal.
mentions.quote: I saw January and I was shown into December right now where we are
mentions.falsify_match: A visible Biden capacity story in January 2024.

mentions.claim_text: Biden's mind appears as grainy static with no reception, and he says the confusion has escalated beyond whatever it had been.
mentions.quote: that's the way it was around Joe Biden's mind
mentions.falsify_match: Biden's cognitive decline becomes an openly reported, escalating story.

mentions.claim_text: Hidden things are exposed at a deeper level at the beginning of 2024, tied to Biden and rewinding back to the Obama administration, with the devil named as the root.
mentions.quote: I saw an exposing of things exposing and a deeper level at the beginning of
mentions.falsify_match: A major early-2024 disclosure linking the Biden circle back to Obama-era figures.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such disclosure in the first half of 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He sees the American economy as a balloon carrying housing and skyscrapers, inflated by someone lowering interest rates and blowing more air in.
mentions.quote: like the economy America all on this big balloon
mentions.falsify_match: Rate cuts through 2024 that visibly reflate asset prices.
mentions.falsify_miss: Rates are held or raised and asset prices do not reflate.

mentions.claim_text: Fed officials say the first inflation worked and nothing bad happened, wait a span of time, then in May into June do it again and the balloon expands further.
mentions.quote: I saw into June into the summer May and into June the summer months
mentions.falsify_match: A second round of easing or stimulus in May or June 2024.
mentions.falsify_miss: No second easing in that window.

mentions.claim_text: In September into October the balloon bursts and is simply gone, and he hears the words quantitative easing, a term he says he had to look up afterwards.
mentions.quote: when it got into September in October I saw the balloon bust
mentions.falsify_match: A market or credit rupture in September or October 2024 answered with quantitative easing.
mentions.falsify_miss: Those two months pass without a rupture.

mentions.claim_text: After October things are different heading into the election, and he refers back to an earlier hollyberries image he says he will explain later.
mentions.quote: I saw October I saw it was like things were different
mentions.falsify_match: A visible regime change in conditions between October and the November 2024 election.
mentions.falsify_miss: Conditions are unchanged across that period.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord tells him to remember, and he sees a great economic crash in the winter months of 2024 going into 2025, with blackness and a great depression he feels as heaviness in the spirit.
mentions.quote: I saw a great economic crash a major crash in the winter months of 2024
mentions.falsify_match: A crash of depression scale beginning in the 2024-25 winter.
mentions.falsify_miss: That winter passes without a crash.

mentions.claim_text: 2025 brings something this generation has never seen, running up into 2026 and 2027, with America completely changed, the wicked judging their work done, and Canada, America and Mexico sharing one currency.
mentions.quote: I saw Canada America and a Mexico becoming one one a one currency
mentions.falsify_match: A shared North American currency or formal monetary union by end of 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: The three countries keep separate currencies.

mentions.claim_text: America's run as top dog of the world economy is over and it is reduced to keeping afloat, with oil among the stronger parts of what he saw going through 2025.
mentions.quote: being the top dog of the of the uh of the world's economy was over
mentions.falsify_match: America loses its position as the largest or dominant world economy.
mentions.falsify_miss: The US keeps the top position.

mentions.claim_text: Back in 2024 he sees an economic boom and things presented as fine, with a televised argument through the spring about a soft landing.
mentions.quote: in 2024 I saw an economic boom I saw things getting better
mentions.falsify_match: A 2024 boom narrative with a public soft-landing debate through the spring.
mentions.falsify_miss: No boom narrative and no soft-landing debate.

mentions.claim_text: Opening remarks saying he has been seeking the Lord about 2024 and does not take lightly warning people about what is coming.
mentions.quote: I've been seeking the Lord about 2024
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing, no claim.

mentions.claim_text: Encouragement that good days are ahead and 2024 is a year to go higher in the spirit.
mentions.quote: in the name of Jesus 2024 is going to be a year
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion for going higher in the spirit.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying this dispensation of time is coming to an end, shown to him through God's eyes during the Thanksgiving and Christmas season.
mentions.quote: this B this been ation of time is coming to an end
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no date and no observable marker for a dispensation ending.

mentions.claim_text: Answering critics who say nothing he has seen has come to pass, he says the Lord told him at the channel's start in March that there would be an acceleration of all things.
mentions.quote: there's going to be an acceleration of all things
mentions.falsify_match: The pace of major world events visibly increases after 2023.
mentions.falsify_miss: The pace of events stays ordinary.

mentions.claim_text: He says he had told viewers to watch Gavin Newsom, who has now made a five-day trip to China ostensibly over the green new deal, and states that Newsom is campaigning.
mentions.quote: he decides to make a trip to China and for 5 days
mentions.falsify_match: Newsom runs for president.
mentions.falsify_miss: Newsom never mounts a presidential campaign.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord tells him personally that the willing and obedient eat the good of the land, and that he is obedient but not yet willing in his heart.
mentions.quote: the willing and obedient will eat the good of the land Brandon
mentions.condition_text: conditional on becoming willing as well as obedient
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: personal word, no external criterion.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord tells him the believer's armour was never designed for retreat but to march forward and take dominion, against the instinct to flee when things get bad.
mentions.quote: I never designed your armor for retreat
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching, no observable claim.

mentions.claim_text: He urges viewers to remain rapture ready for a return at any time rather than assuming ten more years, and recalls being taken to the tribulation where he saw the Pope.
mentions.quote: you all need to remain Rapture Ready ready for him to come at any time
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an any-time claim that no elapsed period can contradict.

mentions.claim_text: A guest says Saudi Arabia is trying to threaten a weakened America and could do so under Biden but not Trump, and warns against making financial decisions on prophecy because God rarely gives an exact timeline.
mentions.quote: don't ever make financial decisions based on words of prophecy
mentions.condition_text: the guest conditions it on who holds the presidency
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim; a guest's conditional read, recorded as context.

mentions.claim_text: In the same interview the question of whether America is Babylon is raised; he says he does not hold that view and believes America still has a great future, against a roughly ten year window put at 2033.
mentions.quote: I think America still has a great future
mentions.falsify_match: America is not destroyed as end-times Babylon and recovers standing by 2033.
mentions.falsify_miss: America collapses in the manner the Babylon reading predicts.
